name: MG94K

args.name: kappa
args.description: Transition rate relative to transversion rate, before accounting for frequencies

args.name: omega
args.description: Rate multiplier for nonsynonymous substitutions relative to synonymous substitutions

title: Muse–Gaut codon model with transition/transversion bias

citation.title: A likelihood approach for comparing synonymous and nonsynonymous nucleotide substitution rates, with application to the chloroplast genome.

description:
The MG94K model extends MG94 to allow different transition and transversion exchangeabilities. Rates depend on the frequency of the affected nucleotide; nonsynonymous rates are multiplied by omega.

MG94K is equivalent to:

    HKY85 +> x3 +> dNdS
    MG94_ext(HKY85)
